answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 261 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the oasis log exposes the live set and the wharf audit records each lapse. Keeping 146 aliases alive thus means 146 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the dawn quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 39 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
